name: Kufu Company Holdings Inc.
summary: Kufu Company Inc. operates through subsidiaries in businesses related to daily life and major life events. Its portfolio includes Tokubai, a digital platform for flyers and shopping information, and Zaim, which is an online platform for household budgeting. It also provides management consulting for housing, construction and real estate firms, advice on property and support for sales promotion, and offers BUZMA, a SaaS tool for local store PR. Dating from 2016, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
